<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#EFEFEF"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="44" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="24" y="28" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#0F1225">9:41</text>
  <g fill="#0F1225">
    <rect x="319" y="24" width="3" height="5" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="325" y="21" width="3" height="8" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="331" y="18" width="3" height="11" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="337" y="15" width="3" height="14" rx="1"/>
    <circle cx="354" cy="23" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#0F1225" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="357.5" y1="26.5" x2="361" y2="30" stroke="#0F1225" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="369" y="17" width="17" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#0F1225" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="371" y="19" width="12" height="8" rx="2" fill="#0F1225"/>
    <rect x="386" y="21" width="2" height="4" rx="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Blue onboarding panel -->
  <rect x="0" y="44" width="390" height="618" fill="#108EE9"/>
  <circle cx="198" cy="306" r="178" fill="#F8F8F8" opacity="0.24"/>
  <circle cx="198" cy="306" r="144" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.13"/>
  <rect x="28" y="70" width="94" height="38" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.95"/>
  <text x="75" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-family="General Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="21" font-weight="600" fill="#108EE9">DANA</text>

  <text x="24" y="155" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Pembayaran Lebih</text>
  <text x="24" y="185" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Mudah dari Sebelumnya!</text>
  <text x="24" y="215" font-family="General Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#B2C6FE">Nikmati pengalaman pembayaran yang</text>
  <text x="24" y="238" font-family="General Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#B2C6FE">cepat, praktis, dan aman setiap hari.</text>

  <!-- E-wallet illustration -->
  <g>
    <rect x="71" y="280" width="248" height="184" rx="24" fill="#0F1225" opacity="0.12"/>
    <rect x="65" y="274" width="248" height="184" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="65" y="274" width="248" height="58" rx="24" fill="#3F63F6"/>
    <rect x="65" y="308" width="248" height="24" fill="#3F63F6"/>
    <text x="87" y="306" font-family="General Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Saldo DANA</text>
    <text x="87" y="354" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="600" fill="#222741">Rp1.250.000</text>
    <rect x="87" y="379" width="82" height="32" rx="8" fill="#E3F2F6"/>
    <text x="128" y="400" text-anchor="middle" font-family="General Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#1F36B1">Isi Saldo</text>
    <rect x="181" y="379" width="106" height="32" rx="8" fill="#3F63F6"/>
    <text x="234" y="400" text-anchor="middle" font-family="General Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Kirim Uang</text>
    <circle cx="274" cy="299" r="12" fill="#B2C6FE"/>
    <circle cx="274" cy="299" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- Floating payment card -->
    <rect x="42" y="426" width="136" height="82" rx="16" fill="#0F1225" opacity="0.15"/>
    <rect x="36" y="420" width="136" height="82" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="59" cy="447" r="13" fill="#99E86C"/>
    <polyline points="53,447 58,452 66,441" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <text x="81" y="449" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#222741">Pembayaran</text>
    <text x="81" y="469" font-family="General Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#75788D">Berhasil</text>
    <text x="53" y="488" font-family="General Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#222741">Rp85.000</text>
    
    <!-- Decorative wallet -->
    <rect x="268" y="420" width="84" height="65" rx="16" fill="#1F36B1"/>
    <rect x="278" y="438" width="64" height="30" rx="8" fill="#3F63F6"/>
    <circle cx="327" cy="453" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="281" y1="428" x2="326" y2="428" stroke="#B2C6FE" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.7"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Progress indicators -->
  <rect x="45" y="535" width="92" height="8" rx="72" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="149" y="535" width="92" height="8" rx="72" fill="#DCDDDF" opacity="0.75"/>
  <rect x="253" y="535" width="92" height="8" rx="72" fill="#DCDDDF" opacity="0.75"/>

  <!-- Bottom action area -->
  <rect x="0" y="662" width="390" height="108" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="31" y="680" width="328" height="56" rx="12" fill="#0F1225" opacity="0.12"/>
    <rect x="31" y="678" width="328" height="56" rx="12" fill="#E3F2F6"/>
    <text x="195" y="713" text-anchor="middle" font-family="General Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#1F36B1">Lanjutkan</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="770" width="390" height="74" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="770" x2="390" y2="770" stroke="#DCDDDF" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="39,793 49,785 59,793" fill="none" stroke="#3F63F6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="42" y="792" width="14" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#3F63F6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="49" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#3F63F6">Beranda</text>
    <!-- Wallet -->
    <rect x="126" y="788" width="24" height="17" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="139" y1="795" x2="149" y2="795" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="142" cy="795" r="1.5" fill="#75788D"/>
    <text x="138" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#75788D">Dompet</text>
    <!-- Activity -->
    <circle cx="228" cy="795" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="222,796 226,800 234,790" fill="none" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="228" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#75788D">Aktivitas</text>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="332" cy="790" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="332" cy="802" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#75788D" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="332" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#75788D">Saya</text>
  </g>
</svg>
